name: CreatePayment
description: Create an idempotent payment intent for a merchant order

name: StartPaymentAttempt
description: Select an eligible merchant channel and start a durable payment attempt

name: ConfirmPaymentResult
description: Record, verify, deduplicate, and adjudicate a channel payment result

name: GetPayment
description: Read a persisted payment and all payment-attempt adjudication summaries

name: VerifyPaymentResult
description: Verify channel authenticity without placing credentials in the aggregate

name: SerializeMerchantOrderSuccess
description: Serialize accepted-success decisions for one merchant before evaluating the merchant-order claim

name: StartChannelPayment
description: Submit a payment attempt to the selected external channel

name: CreatePaymentEndpoint
description: POST /api/payments

name: StartPaymentAttemptEndpoint
description: POST /api/payments/{paymentId}/attempts

name: ConfirmPaymentResultEndpoint
description: POST /api/channel/payment-results

name: GetPaymentEndpoint
description: GET /api/payments/{paymentId}

name: CreateRefund
description: Reserve payment refund budget, create a refund, and submit one channel attempt

name: ConfirmRefundResult
description: Record, verify, deduplicate, and adjudicate a channel refund result

name: ReviewPendingRefunds
description: Mark accepted refunds without final results as review required after the configured threshold

name: GetRefund
description: Read a persisted refund with attempts and notification adjudication evidence

name: StartChannelRefund
description: Submit a refund attempt to the selected external channel

name: VerifyRefundResult
description: Verify refund-channel authenticity without placing credentials in the aggregate

name: CreateRefundEndpoint
description: POST /api/refunds

name: ConfirmRefundResultEndpoint
description: POST /api/channel/refund-results

name: GetRefundEndpoint
description: GET /api/refunds/{refundId}

name: RunDailyReconciliation
description: Idempotently create or load a daily batch, pull a statement revision, load platform facts, and reconcile it

name: RerunReconciliationBatch
description: Explicitly pull and process a statement revision for an existing reconciliation batch

name: DisposeReconciliationDifference
description: Authorize and append a disposition, optionally forming a separate confirmation fact

name: GetReconciliationBatch
description: Read a reconciliation batch with immutable run, item, disposition, and confirmation evidence

name: PullChannelStatement
description: Pull one immutable revisioned channel statement for a reconciliation scope

name: LoadPlatformReconciliationFacts
description: Project immutable payment and refund facts for a reconciliation scope without returning aggregate write models

name: GetReconciliationBatchEndpoint
description: GET /api/reconciliation-batches/{batchId}

name: RerunReconciliationBatchEndpoint
description: POST /api/reconciliation-batches/{batchId}/reruns

name: DisposeReconciliationDifferenceEndpoint
description: POST /api/reconciliation-items/{itemId}/dispositions

name: PrepareMerchantSettlement
description: Idempotently prepare one daily merchant settlement from current effective reconciliation facts

name: RunDailyMerchantSettlement
description: Scheduled daily merchant settlement preparation for one merchant channel currency scope

name: ConfirmMerchantSettlement
description: Authorize and freeze a prepared merchant settlement composition

name: StartMerchantSettlementExecution
description: Submit a confirmed positive settlement or retry after an explicit failed attempt

name: ConfirmMerchantSettlementResult
description: Verify and adjudicate one external settlement result notification

name: AdjudicateMerchantSettlementResult
description: Append an authorized final conclusion to an unknown merchant settlement result without deleting receipt history

name: ReviewUnknownMerchantSettlements
description: Move overdue unknown settlement attempts into manual review without creating a payment retry

name: VoidMerchantSettlement
description: Void a settlement before external execution and optionally create a replacement chain

name: ReturnMerchantSettlementForAdjustment
description: Return an unconfirmed merchant settlement for adjustment and prepare a fresh effective replacement

name: GetMerchantSettlement
description: Read the full merchant settlement scope, lines, fee evidence, execution attempts, receipts, conflicts, and replacement trail

name: LoadMerchantSettlementCandidates
description: Project eligible and excluded current-effective-run facts for a merchant settlement period

name: StartSettlementTransfer
description: Submit one idempotent settlement transfer request to the reference provider

name: VerifySettlementResult
description: Verify and normalize one reference settlement result notification

name: PrepareMerchantSettlementEndpoint
description: POST /api/merchant-settlements

name: ConfirmMerchantSettlementEndpoint
description: POST /api/merchant-settlements/{settlementId}/confirmations

name: StartMerchantSettlementExecutionEndpoint
description: POST /api/merchant-settlements/{settlementId}/executions

name: ConfirmMerchantSettlementResultEndpoint
description: POST /api/channel/settlement-results

name: VoidMerchantSettlementEndpoint
description: POST /api/merchant-settlements/{settlementId}/voids

name: GetMerchantSettlementEndpoint
description: GET /api/merchant-settlements/{settlementId}

name: MerchantSettlementActivationRequested
description: Activate replacement settlement ownership after the predecessor release has been persisted

name: ActivateMerchantSettlement
description: Activate the effective scope and source-consumption ownership of a replacement settlement

name: ChannelStatementAvailable
description: Signal that a revisioned channel statement is available for authoritative pull

name: MerchantSettlementCompleted
description: A merchant settlement formed its first accepted terminal success fact

name: ProcessAvailableChannelStatement
description: Pull and reconcile the exact statement revision announced by an inbound availability event

name: MerchantSettlementCompleted
description: A merchant settlement formed its first accepted terminal success fact

name: ExpirePayments
description: Idempotently close expired payments without pending attempts or move pending attempts into result review

name: AdjudicatePaymentReview
description: Append an authorized decision to one payment review without deleting evidence

name: AdjudicatePaymentReviewEndpoint
description: POST /api/payments/{paymentId}/reviews/{reviewId}/decisions
